scope: Complete standalone application and real registered Audio Studio handlers in a test-local DOM/event adapter; canonical authoring, native-input isolation, canvas/native envelope synchronization and persistence contracts. Mock AudioContext sink only. Does not establish mobile keyboard activation, browser layout, trusted pointer behavior, audible output or hardware acceptance.

results.name: Desktop tracker piano keys, navigation, cut and clear still use the selected instrument
Desktop repeated keys and unsupported DPCM do not add unintended note edits
Existing instrument name and numeric fields keep native typing without tracker edits
Audio Studio exposes native note, octave, instrument and volume controls without a physical keyboard
Mobile note entry changes exactly the chosen order, channel and row while retaining existing effect data
Mobile clear and cut preserve volume and effect fields and create one undoable edit each
Mobile entry accepts canonical note endpoints and blank inherited instrument and volume values
Malformed mobile cell fields are rejected atomically instead of coercing or partially saving
Invalid order, row and channel addresses cannot write another cell or add history
Mobile entry retains the no-instrument and unsupported DPCM boundaries
A mobile cell edit round-trips through undo, redo and the existing portable project format
Ordinary Audio sidebar refreshes preserve an unfinished native draft without mutating the project
Changing selected cells loads the new values and cannot apply an old draft to the old address
Native mobile fields keep typing, editing shortcuts and arrows isolated from tracker and emulator actions
Focused Audio entry buttons contain tracker hotkeys without suppressing normal button activation keys
Browser preview playback prevents mobile edits from following a moving row
Native envelope values update only the chosen existing instrument step and round-trip with history
Malformed envelope values or step addresses do not clamp, extend arrays or create history
